## What's new in 0.2.0

### Tasks, Kanban & Batch Operations
- **Kanban boards & sections.** Redesigned Kanban columns and cards with drag-and-drop column reordering, section management and board options, subsections, live smart-add inside column inputs, and confirmation before deleting sections.
- **Multi-level nested tasks.** Full drag-and-drop nesting and unlinking in both List and Kanban views, tree integrity rules, `{done}/{total}` subtask and checklist progress counts on rows and cards, and subtask due-date display.
- **Batch Edit & Batch Add.** Select multiple tasks to reschedule, change priority or tags, move, complete, merge, duplicate, convert between tasks and notes, or delete in one step. Pasting multiple lines into Quick Add (both the main bar and global Quick Add window) opens a Batch Add confirmation modal to create all tasks at once.
- **Live-sliding sidebar drag-and-drop.** Smoothly reorder lists, folders, tags, filters, smart lists, and sections directly in the sidebar rail and lists panel.
- **Inline title editing & Countdown Mode.** Click a task title to edit in place at the clicked cursor position without baseline shift. Click any task due-date pill (or enable Countdown Mode in Settings → Date & Time) to toggle remaining-day countdowns across List, Kanban, and Matrix views.

### Smarter Quick Add, Scheduling & Recurrence
- **Upgraded global Quick Add window.** Always-on-top mode, live highlighted smart-add spans, date and repeat chips, live priority coloring and tooltips, `#tag` preview, `~list`/`^list` live list picker preview, and multi-line batch add.
- **Expanded natural-language parsing (EN / RU / ZH).** Recognizes month-first and slash dates (`11/25`, `2026/11/25`), ordinal dates, day after tomorrow, next weekday/week/month/year, weekend, time-of-day keywords (`morning`, `noon`, `afternoon`, `evening`), shorthand priorities (`!!!`, `!!`, `!h`/`!m`/`!l`, `!p1`–`!p3`), `~list` syntax, and repeating rules (weekdays/workdays, every other day/week, biweekly, weekends, and localized weekday repeats).
- **Advanced recurrence & reminders.** Added Ebbinghaus forgetting-curve schedules, lunar calendar dates, weekday/workday repeats, **Complete & End Repeat** in the task context menu, constant reminders, task location pins, full date-range highlighting in Duration mode, **Clear Date** in Postpone Overdue, a quick **Start Focus** action on reminder banners, and **Clear all** in the Notification Bell popover.

### Calendar, Timeline & Two-Way CalDAV Sync
- **Two-way CalDAV sync & Event Editor.** Pull, create, edit, and delete events on CalDAV calendars with ETag conflict recovery and `TZID` preservation, backed by an upgraded Event Editor with `Enter` submit, live validation, and flexible date/time parsing.
- **Calendar & Timeline enhancements.** Added a secondary time zone axis (with DST offset shift awareness), side-by-side lane layout for overlapping timed tasks, separated folded night bands, collapsible Arrange Tasks groups, and `Left`/`Right`/`T` keyboard navigation.
- **Interactive marks & faster navigation.** Priority-tinted clickable checkboxes and tooltips on Calendar Agenda rows, Calendar task bars, and Timeline bars; click `+N` overflow badges or double-click day numbers in Month view to jump straight to Day view; hover tooltips on Year View heatmap cells.

### Habits & Eisenhower Matrix
- **Habits overhaul.** Supports decimal goals, Auto/Manual/All check-in modes, Done/Undone/Unlabeled statuses, skipped dates, mood-tagged logs, manual drag-and-drop reordering, and Focus auto check-in linking. Includes a unified create/edit modal with 15-minute reminder picker, interactive 7-day progress strip with single-date filter, resizable detail panel with 1-click Today check-in, Daily Goals chart, habit cycles, log timeline, localized date formatting, and integrations across Calendar, Global Search, and Statistics.
- **Eisenhower Matrix overhaul.** Added custom Matrix profiles (create, rename, switch, and delete with confirmation), a modal rule editor for quadrants, full drag-and-drop between quadrants, keyboard navigation, inline expand/collapse for parent subtasks, context menus, detail card, live smart-add inside quadrant inputs, and note/subtask/reminder/location/countdown indicators.

### Focus, Audio & System Tray
- **Focus timer & mini window.** Added a configurable Daily Focus Goal with progress bar in Overview, 1-click duration preset chips (`15`/`25`/`45`/`60m`), `Space` start/pause/resume shortcut, live running timer pill on the sidebar rail icon, hover tooltips on Focus statistics and timeline blocks, and confirmation before batch-deleting Focus records. The floating Focus Mini window gains a Pomodoro progress bar, running/paused indicator, `Space`/`Escape` controls, and full task title tooltip.
- **Synthesized sound effects & Ticking.** Added synthesized task completion and Pomodoro chimes (with Settings toggle) and optional **Ticking** ambient focus sound with quick-toggle buttons in Focus, Focus Mini, and Settings.
- **Windows system tray & global hotkeys.** Persistent Windows tray menu with Focus quick-start, live Focus timer tooltip, Always on Top toggle, and Close-to-Tray behavior, alongside global hotkeys for Quick Add, Show/Hide App (restoring from tray), Focus Mini Window, and Pin/Unpin Window.

### Settings, Themes, Shortcuts & Rich Editing
- **Separate Settings window & custom JSONC themes.** Settings now opens in its own desktop window with Reset defaults for Task Defaults and an Always on Top toggle. Custom user themes in JSONC format load through `ThemeRegistry` with automatic live-reload from the themes directory.
- **Interactive Shortcuts page & `keymap.json`.** Rebuilt Shortcuts as a full Settings page with interactive key recording, conflict detection, explicit recording rules and rejection feedback, 1-click Clear and Reset defaults, and bidirectional comment-preserving `keymap.json` overrides including a complete self-documented action and context reference.
- **Expanded keyboard shortcuts.** Added `Ctrl+K` Search, `Ctrl+S` Sync Now, `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` global and per-input Undo/Redo, `MinimizeWindow`, Print List/Detail, view/list switching chords, Focus controls, Sticky Note Pin/Color/Collapse/Edge-align actions, and all 11 Markdown formatting shortcuts (`Ctrl+B`/`I`/`U`/`K`, etc.).
- **Markdown editor, Task Details & Summary.** Interactive clickable checkboxes in note preview, automatic Markdown list/checklist/quote continuation on `Enter`, `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` indent/outdent, word navigation/deletion, double/triple-click selection, smart URL wrapping on `Ctrl+K`, checklist **Uncheck All** / **Clear Completed** buttons, clickable comment Send button, live footer word count, 1-click Task Estimation preset chips, **Copy as Markdown** / **Copy as Plain Text** with Copied feedback across Task Detail and Summary, and overwrite confirmation plus Reset in Summary.
- **Global Search, Sticky Notes & UI polish.** Global Search adds `Up`/`Down` keyboard navigation, in-place clickable task checkboxes, quick task creation on empty results (`Enter`), habits filter, and archived/note/emoji badges. Sticky Notes gain a visible collapse/expand titlebar button and compact title tooltip. Added overlay scrollbars across scrollable views and popovers, dynamic Today and Next 7 Days sidebar badges, clickable empty-state prompts, confirmation modals for destructive actions (Lists, Tags, Filters, Countdowns, Sections, Matrix profiles, Focus records, and Trash), and a faster modular workspace build architecture.

## Bug fixes

- **Database transactions, storage & sync.** Unified savepoint transactions (`in_tx`), cycle-safe descendant queries, atomic parent/subtask/section/tag mutations, automatic attachment file unlinking and garbage collection on purge, multi-level tag hierarchy queries, and missing database indexes. Hardened device sync with LWW watermarks, forward-compatible column handling, separator safety, atomic sync finalization, bounded sync reads, and safer undo/redo on repeating tasks.
- **CalDAV & background I/O.** Fixed CalDAV partial-push and HTTP `412 Precondition Failed` ETag recovery, reused DAV HTTP clients, and moved ICS parsing, reminder polling, audio synthesis, backup/import, sync, keymap I/O, and printing off the UI thread. Added search/sync debouncing and theme-watcher cleanup.
- **Render & drag performance.** Eliminated SQLite queries from render and drag paths across Todo, Task Detail, Calendar, Matrix, Habits, Countdown, Focus, Summary, Settings, and Search views via cached lookups and an O(N) `TaskTree` index.
- **Scheduling, calendar, countdown & search accuracy.** Preserved due time and duration spans during context-menu rescheduling, Batch Edit, Suggested Tasks, Matrix quick dates, and Kanban date-column drops. Fixed midnight overflow and same-day end-time clamping in the Date Picker, month/year rollovers in Countdown Standard `+1 day` spans, multi-day span filtering in Search, `Show Completed` in Tomorrow and Next 7 Days views, DST shifts in Focus and Calendar dual-timezone views, timed drag-resize bounds, folded night band alignment, and Year View safety on zero/tiny viewports.
- **Text input, Markdown, import & printing.** Fixed `TextInput` panics, IME/paste/list edge cases, Unicode masking, and caret baseline/selection offsets. Preserved open task detail drafts across background refreshes, fixed location-input focus detection and checklist/comment row hover isolation, stripped invalid XML control characters from SVG exports, fixed recursive subtask printing (preserving Notes, Won't Do, and priority), mapped localized Inbox names (`Входящие`, `收集箱`) during CSV import, and unified Russian «Помодоро» wording.
- **Windows native stability & UI polish.** Hardened Win32 global hotkeys (including clean shutdown), tray icon lifecycle, single-instance guard, updater, and sticky note `HWND`/`MINMAXINFO` guards; deduplicated sticky popup lifecycles and fixed `CloseWindow` targeting. Fixed scrollbar drag cleanup on unmount/focus loss, modal backdrop occlusion and title wrapping, narrow-window `min_w_0` clipping across AppView/Calendar/Matrix/Task Detail, Summary edited-report export and rapid-copy timer cancellation, transient popup dismissal, and cross-platform Linux/macOS builds and tests.
